scope: Only seven AI eligibility-policy controls; all76 source homes and their other printed-rule tests remain active.
root_decision: Preserve legal expectations and complete scripts/diagnostics separately, consistently with the earlier mana AI-zero components. These are not unimplemented cards and no gameplay-failure baselines are created.

source_oracle.name: Gyre Sage
source_oracle.oracle_text:
Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)
{T}: Add {G} for each +1/+1 counter on this creature.

components.reason: The AI-only EVENT_CAN_ACTIVATE policy requires a positive counter count. Printed tap-for-zero remains legal. The ordinary activation API honors that eligibility query; no policy override or expected-false substitution is introduced.

source_oracle.name: Pull from the Deep
source_oracle.oracle_text: Return up to one target instant card and up to one target sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile Pull from the Deep.

components.reason: The explicit AI EVENT_CAN_CAST policy declines the spell unless an eligible own graveyard card exists. Printed up-to-one plus up-to-one permits choosing no targets. Human zero-target controls remain active; no forced AI cast or changed legal expectation is introduced.
